description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system, specifying a method for logging messages with various details and optional exceptions. It serves as a contract for implementing logging nodes in an Android application.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for logging components that can output log data to various targets and can be chained together.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Defines a method for logging a message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
